verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a dedicated SOC 2 program that it says automates 'the SOC 2 process at every step' to get audit ready, with 200+ controls condensed into guided steps. Supported frameworks include control mapping to requirements and automated control testing that collects evidence from integrations. Auditor-approved policy templates and an AI-assisted policy editor cover the required policies. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of Type I vs Type II support (including Type II observation-period handling), explicit naming of the Trust Services Criteria, a documented auditor evidence-request workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor claims.
